layers.name: Financial Data Operations
layers.description: Orchestrates fetching, transformation, and persistence of financial market and fund data from external sources.

layers.name: Domain Models
layers.description: Defines core domain entities representing financial instruments, valuations, and analysis metrics.

layers.name: API Endpoints
layers.description: Exposes HTTP endpoints for financial data operations including stocks, funds, and analysis tools.

layers.name: Application Infrastructure
layers.description: Provides application entry points, configuration, and core services including Redis caching and message queue management.

layers.name: Helper Functions
layers.description: Provides reusable helper functions for data formatting, HTTP operations, caching, and mathematical calculations.

layers.name: Domain Types
layers.description: TypeScript type definitions and interfaces for financial trading domain entities and data structures.
